question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution’.**

To stay healthy, **__you must keep away from smoking__**.

options.text: you can keep away from smoking.
you will keep away from smoking.
you may keep away from smoking.

solution:
The correct answer is** "No substitution."**

• The original sentence is already grammatically correct and effective in conveying its message.
 
• There doesn't seem to be any error in the sentence: **"To stay healthy, you must keep away from smoking."**
 
• It is grammatically correct and conveys a clear message.
